Alright OP, you want a list? I got a list.

GET RIGHT NOW:

  • Soul Sacrifice Delta: Fantastic game all around, and easily my favorite game on the platform
  • Disgaea 3 + 4: A fairly popular strategy RPG series with well received games on the vita.
  • Persona 4 Golden: P4G is essentially Persona 4, but with some small extras like player hints and an extra character.
  • Gravity Rush: came out in the early days of the vita, but it's still really good.
  • Demon Gaze: If you like games similar to might and magic, this is a good game to try out.

CONSIDER IT:

  • Freedom wars: It plays similar to soul sacrifice delta, but has guns and grappling hooks. The story is nowhere near the quality of SSD, though.
  • Neptunia Rebirth: I'm generally not a fan of games that cater to the anime crowd so hard, but the gameplay was solid (traditional JRPG).
  • Tales of Hearts: It's a cookie cutter Tales game, but the story isn't really up to par with what we've had in the past with the franchise.
  • Little Big Planet: The singleplayer is what you'd want out of an LBG game, but the multiplayer sucks (due to technical issues).
  • Danganronpa: It's kind of like a visual novel. Sort of.

AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE:

  • Borderlands 2: The vita version is the worst port of this game. It's got frequent FPS chugs, awkward controls, and extended load times.
  • Soul Sacrifice: Literally no point in buying this ever since delta came out. SSD has the original game and several gameplay improvements.
  • Killzone Mercenary: It's a decent shooter, made to highlight the features of the vita.
